# Example Area Instructions

## Purpose

Provide shared guidance for assistants working on this project's platform integrations.

## Scope

- Applies to integration design and implementation work
- Complements folder-level `CLAUDE.md` files
- Should not duplicate instructions that are already local to one folder

## Instructions

- Prefer existing platform conventions and scripts over introducing new tools
- Keep automation idempotent and environment-safe
- Document assumptions when touching external services or APIs
